page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.large is a compute-optimized virtual instance provisioned through KVM virtualization. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 Hygon 7447v processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. Accompanied by 4.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core), adhering to typical compute-oriented architectures where processor density is prioritized over expansive memory capacity.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for system and data persistence. Outbound connectivity operates at a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. The server configuration also excludes discrete GPU accelerators and complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which reflects a streamlined design intended for purely CPU-driven network services.

In terms of operational resource allocation, the dedicated core assignment ensures consistent CPU execution without noisy-neighbor contention. With 4.0 GB of memory and no local disks, memory-heavy in-memory caching or storage-intensive I/O configurations face architectural bottlenecks. Instead, the resource distribution yields qualitative efficiency for small-footprint workloads where compute performance and minimal overhead are primary objectives.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.large is structured for workloads such as basic web serving, API gateways, microservices, continuous integration runners, lightweight utility processing, and batch tasks that do not require high memory capacity or local disk persistence.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.large is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Driven by a 2.6 GHz Hygon 7447v processor, it supplies 2 dedicated vCPUs alongside 4.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:2 compute profile with 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is delivered without bundled local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, relying on external network storage for disk operations and supporting a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. With dedicated CPU allocation, ecs.c9h.large maintains predictable CPU execution characteristics without burst limitations. This configuration provides a lean, resource-efficient computing environment suited for lightweight web serving, front-end application proxies, microservice deployments, small CI/CD build agents, and automated background batch processing tasks.
